evidence.quote: A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow
allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react

criteria.reasoning: Clear goals, users and need for GBR bleaching monitoring with quantitative context and literature links. Specific payload functions identified. Fully fits Accomplished descriptor.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart.

criteria.reasoning: Gantt with weekly tasks and deadlines plus task narratives shows feasibility. Lacks explicit contingencies/variations and clear referenced information-source plan, so not robust Accomplished.

evidence.quote: My current choice is a geostationary orbit at an altitude of 600 km,

criteria.reasoning: No results, calculations or simulations presented, only background reading and tutorials. Single orbit statement is technically wrong, showing insufficient on-track technical progress.

evidence.quote: Australia’s Great Barrier Reef is the largest coral reef in the world,

criteria.reasoning: Logical headings, clear writing, consistent formatting and readable Gantt. Footnote URLs support text. Minor gaps like no figure caption do not impede reading.

technical_issues.issue: States geostationary orbit at 600 km altitude: conflates LEO sun-synchronous-type altitude with GEO (~35,786 km); geostationary cannot be fixed over reef at that altitude.

overall: Strong mission rationale and planning presentation, but preliminary technical work is minimal and contains a major orbit error needing correction in Part 2.
